LAC is a prior ISO code because Maya Naha speakers have been lumped in with Lacandon de Lacanja in which a NT has been done. 900 people in 4 communities of the Ososingo Municipio, Chiapas use this unique language when speaking to each other. Several Maya Naha speakers have begun a new translation on their own using the Lacandon de Lacanja NT as a reference because Lacandon de Lacanja is not well understood by most Maya Naha speakers. LAC is a prior ISO code because Maya Naha speakers have been lumped in with Lacandon de Lacanja in which a NT has been done. 900 people in 4 communities of the Ososingo Municipio, Chiapas use this unique language when speaking to each other. ILV created a Maya Naha dictionary and facilitated a translation of Luke & part of Acts some 25 years ago. Several Maya Naha speakers have begun a new translation on their own using the Lacandon de Lacanja NT as a reference because Lacandon de Lacanja is not well understood by most Maya Naha speakers. Mexican Bible Society has been minimally assisting the Maya Naha translators but plans to start a full project early 2021 with the financial support of Seed Co.

LAC is a prior ISO code because Maya Naha speakers have been lumped in with Lacandon de Lacanja in which a NT has been done. 900 people in 4 communities of the Ososingo Municipio, Chiapas use this unique language when speaking to each other. ILV created a Maya Naha dictionary and facilitated a translation of Luke & part of Acts some 25 years ago. Several Maya Naha speakers have begun a new translation on their own using the Lacandon de Lacanja NT as a reference because Lacandon de Lacanja is not well understood by most Maya Naha speakers. Mexican Bible Society has been minimally assisting the Maya Naha translators but plans to start a full project early 2021 with the financial support of Seed Co.
